original_font_information.description: Biform is a sans-serif font with a monospace vibe and elegant details. It features two styles: regular and pixel, which are perfectly interchangeable. Biform means combining the forms of two distinct creatures. Zeus taking the body of a bull can be called a biform; or a satyr is a biform too.
